## EVIDENCE span:c-climate-001-b26d226f500be322-9#chars-1703-1928

## EVIDENCE span:c-climate-004-c15bf91ea851c3be-6#chars-682-1011

## EVIDENCE span:c-climate-004-c15bf91ea851c3be-10#chars-1730-1831
